name: mid
notes: Liquidity ranks 251 to 1,000 by 3-month trailing-median dollar volume; membership = size-1,000 universe minus size-250 universe of the same month.
Not index membership. Survivorship-free by construction (selected from each month's whole-market cross-section). Same screens as the frozen universe: non-ETF, non-test issue, close >= 5.
Snapshots after 2025-06-30 are not built: the sealed holdout starts 2025-08-26.
coverage_class is 'partial' before 2017-10-26, where symbol.last_seen has no data and delisting is inferred only from a name leaving the cross-section.
